name: Solar & Battery
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional solar and battery company. Ask about the property type, roof type, existing system, and energy goals. Ask about switchboard capacity and whether a battery or EV charger is wanted. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise rebate amounts, payback times, or system performance that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Yes, we hold [electrical licence type] licence [licence number] and [insurer] insurance. Certificates are available on request.
{price_note} Solar is priced by system size in kW, including panels, inverter and installation. We give you a quote after a site visit.
Yes, we install home and commercial batteries. We check your switchboard and inverter compatibility before we quote.
Yes, we repair and replace inverters. Tell us the brand, model and any error code on the display so we can book the right visit.
Yes, we clean solar panels. Cleaning is priced as listed on your quote, and we confirm the price before we start.
Yes, we offer solar service visits. A service checks the panels, inverter output and connections, and we list any faults we find.
Rebates and incentives change and vary by state and system size. We tell you which ones may apply to your system at the quote stage.
Yes, we install EV chargers and can connect them to your solar system. Tell us where the charger will go so we can check your switchboard.
Yes, we install off-grid and hybrid systems. We size the battery and panels to your daily power use, so please share your power bills.
Yes, we do commercial solar installs. Commercial work is quoted separately after a site visit.

kb.q: What roof types do you work on?
kb.a: We work on [roof types you cover, e.g. tile, metal and flat roofs]. We check the roof condition and fixing points before installation.
A typical home installation takes [number] days, depending on system size and roof access. We confirm the timing when you book.
Yes, we upgrade panels, inverters and batteries. We check the existing system first so the new parts match it.
Yes, we do solar inspections, including pre-purchase checks. An inspection covers the panels, inverter and wiring, and we summarise what we find.
{warranty_note} Please ask us to explain what each product warranty covers before you buy.
We service [your service area]. Ask us to confirm your suburb before booking.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: Yes, someone must be home or able to give access on install day. Put any key or gate code details in the access notes.
Yes, we upgrade switchboards as part of the install where needed. We tell you if an upgrade is required before the work starts.
A battery system can provide backup power if it is designed for that purpose. Tell us which circuits you want backed up so we can size the system.
Yes, we can monitor system performance remotely if your inverter supports it. We confirm the monitoring options when you get a quote.

compliance.guidance: Solar installers need accreditation and electrical licence coverage for the grid connection, and a clean energy approved installer status where a rebate applies. Check your state rules and the rebate scheme requirements.
